user_saw: Memory Wiki could miss relevant pages for Cyrillic or Japanese queries and rank unrelated pages first for accented Latin queries.
summary: The fix preserves Unicode letters, numbers, and combining marks when splitting Memory Wiki queries into search terms.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already used the ASCII-only splitter in page scoring, where term matching required at least one token. The available path history stops at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify whether the splitter shipped with search or replaced earlier working behavior.
